company.name: Packlink
company.shortDescription: Packlink & Packlink PRO are an online platform that offers cost-effective package delivery services in Spain and internationally.
company.description:
Packlink is an online platform that offers cost-effective package delivery services in Spain, Germany, France, Italy and internationally. 

Since 2015 Packlink also introduced a business solution which is called Packlink PRO to enable cost-effective package delivery for businesses.

It enables users to compare all available package delivery options offered by different service providers and pick a suitable service to get their parcels delivered.

Packlink was launched in January 2011.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,314,898 to $61,024,118, a 9.66x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 27 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 4 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
